suites.name: Poppler registered upstream suites with pinned corpus
command:
mkdir -p /build/poppler-test-data
tar -xzf /test-assets/test-0ef006dca68d2206387eca1d36ae06733812e387.tar.gz --strip-components=1 -C /build/poppler-test-data
test -f /build/poppler-test-data/test-poppler.c
cmake -S . -B obj-x86_64-linux-gnu -DTESTDATADIR=/build/poppler-test-data -DBUILD_GTK_TESTS=ON -DBUILD_QT5_TESTS=ON -DBUILD_CPP_TESTS=ON
cmake --build obj-x86_64-linux-gnu --parallel 2
cd obj-x86_64-linux-gnu
ctest -N | tee /build/poppler-discovered-tests.log
grep -Eq 'Total Tests: [1-9][0-9]*' /build/poppler-discovered-tests.log
grep -q 'check_qt5_' /build/poppler-discovered-tests.log
ctest -V --output-on-failure --timeout 120 | tee /build/poppler-executed-tests.log
if grep -Eq 'Totals:.*[1-9][0-9]* skipped|[0-9]+ - .*\(Not Run\)' /build/poppler-executed-tests.log; then
  echo 'Unexpected skipped upstream tests' >&2
  exit 1
fi
